Notice Of Motion And Motion To Quash Defts' Medical Records Subpoenas
Off Calendar Mar-13-2007 Text Ruling
MINI MINUTES:
NO APPEARANCE. TENTATIVE RULING ADOPTED. Plaintiff Juan Alvarez' motion to quash or modify medical records subpoena is granted in part. The subpoena as to Saint Francis Memorial Hospital is modified to only require production of records from January 1, 1997 to the present. The subpoena to Saint Luke's hospital is modified to only require production of any orthopedic or other records relating to treatment of plaintiff's shoulders, extremities, back and spinal column from January 1, 1997 to the present. COMMISSIONER: BRUCE E. CHAN.
